mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or quarterly GDPC1 growth fails to correlate with subsequent SPX returns (Pearson r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interactions between rising PAYEMS (indicating labor market strength) and low UNRATE (< 3.5%) create a 'goldilocks' zone, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to predict positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances, or the interaction's partial correlation with SPX returns is insignificant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling supply chain disruptions, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced productivity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances with 2-month INDPRO declines, or the signal's walk-forward IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive RSAFS growth, indicating robust household spending, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to sustained consumer demand.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of RSAFS growth with SPX returns remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of quarters with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between FEDFUNDS (below 1%) and rising CPIAUCSL (above 2% YoY) indicates accommodative monetary policy fueling inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to predict negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances, or the interaction's partial correlation with SPX returns is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (below 3%) without corresponding PAYEMS growth indicates labor market inefficiencies, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors reassess labor costs.
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to predict negative 5d returns in > 55% of instances, or the interaction's walk-forward IC with SPX returns remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a post-shock recovery regime, positive HOUST growth (above 5% YoY) supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, indicating revived housing demand and broader economic recovery.
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery regimes, SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 45% of quarters with positive HOUST growth above 5% YoY, or the signal's walk-forward IC with SPX returns in this regime remains below 0.02.
